subject.title: fix(mac): opening General Settings crashes in packaged app

question: Should the macOS release owner accept the explicit fail-closed generated-resource packaging contract after the branch is rebased and the macOS package proof is refreshed?
rationale: The implementation is a focused crash fix with positive real-app evidence, but it changes the release packaging contract for a third-party SwiftPM resource and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Rebase and land with refreshed macOS proof
options.body: Keep the bundle copy and lockfile guard, then validate the exact merge-result app includes the resource and survives opening General Settings.

options.title: Pause for a different dependency ownership model
options.body: Do not merge until the release owner prefers an upstream package change or another supported resource-distribution contract over explicit app packaging.

recommendation.title: Rebase and land with refreshed macOS proof
recommendation.body: Keep the bundle copy and lockfile guard, then validate the exact merge-result app includes the resource and survives opening General Settings.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and PR evidence place this contributor closest to the macOS packaging and release-validation path.
